stories.title: Veja o que abre e o que fecha durante o feriado de Nossa Senhora Aparecida em BH

en.title: See what opens and what closes during the Our Lady of Aparecida holiday in BH
en.summary: Public services in Belo Horizonte will have altered schedules on Monday, October 12 for the Our Lady of Aparecida holiday. Emergency health facilities operate normally, while other services have modified hours.

stories.title: Devotas atribuem cura a Nossa Senhora Aparecida e retribuem com apoio a romeiros

en.title: Devotees attribute healing to Our Lady of Aparecida and reciprocate with support for pilgrims
en.summary: Two women dedicated Sunday to caring for pilgrims traveling along Presidente Dutra highway toward the sanctuary after attributing personal recoveries to Our Lady of Aparecida. One provides water after her daughter's cardiac issue, the other volunteered after her breast cancer diagnosis.

stories.title: Nossa Senhora Aparecida: confira a programação do Dia da Padroeira em Macapá

en.title: Our Lady of Aparecida: check the schedule of Patroness Day in Macapá
en.summary: The parish community in Macapá will celebrate the Feast Day of Brazil's patroness on Monday, October 12, with activities including rosary prayer, a bike pilgrimage, and masses throughout the day.

stories.title: Guerra jurídica no 1º turno teve Nossa Senhora, debate e ao menos 470 ações de Lula e Flávio

en.title: Legal war in first round had Our Lady, debate and at least 470 actions by Lula and Flávio
en.summary: President Lula and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro filed at least 470 legal actions with Brazil's Electoral Court from the start of the campaign through the first round of elections.

stories.title: Decisões de Kassio contra Lula e a favor de Flávio incomodam ala do TSE e geram críticas

en.title: Kassio's decisions against Lula and in favor of Flávio concern TSE wing and generate criticism
en.summary: The TSE president's decision to censor a WhatsApp channel supporting Lula has drawn criticism from within and outside the court, alongside other controversial rulings during the electoral campaign.

stories.title: Lula reúne multidão na Paulista, e esquerda replica atos pelo país em busca de onda contra Flávio

en.title: Lula gathers crowds on Paulista Avenue, and left replicates acts across the country seeking wave against Flávio
en.summary: Trailing in voter intention polls, President Lula held a large rally on São Paulo's Paulista Avenue and directed his message toward young supporters, with leftist movements organizing similar events nationwide.

stories.title: Zagueiro critica diretoria do Corinthians e cobra salários atrasados após goleada

en.title: Defender criticizes Corinthians board and demands overdue salaries after rout
en.summary: Following a 4-1 defeat to Palmeiras, Corinthians defender Gabriel Paulista publicly criticized the club's leadership and demanded payment of overdue wages.

stories.title: Técnico interino defende elenco do Corinthians e elogia contratação de Seedorf

en.title: Interim coach defends Corinthians squad and praises Seedorf signing
en.summary: The interim coach expressed support for the Corinthians roster and voiced approval of the club's recruitment of Seedorf.

stories.title: Gabriel Paulista chora, desabafa e critica diretoria do Corinthians: ‘Estou vivendo um pesadelo’

en.title: Gabriel Paulista cries, vents and criticizes Corinthians board: 'I'm living a nightmare'
en.summary: Gabriel Paulista expressed frustration and emotional distress regarding his situation at Corinthians, publicly criticizing the club's management.

stories.title: 'Isso não é ação, é execução', diz leitora sobre jovem morto com 27 tiros pela PM

en.title: 'This is not action, it is execution', says reader about young man killed with 27 shots by PM
en.summary: A reader criticized police action in which a young person was fatally shot multiple times by officers in São Paulo's south zone.

stories.title: TSE barra anúncios de Lula acusando Flávio de ser contra escala 6x1

en.title: TSE bars Lula ads accusing Flávio of opposing 6x1 work shift
en.summary: Brazil's electoral court prohibited paid campaign advertisements claiming a political candidate opposes ending the 6x1 work schedule, acting on a suspension request.

stories.title: Corregedor derruba decisão que suspendeu canal Exército do Lula

en.title: Electoral ombudsman overturns decision that suspended 'Lula's Army' channel
en.summary: The electoral ombudsman reversed a suspension of a WhatsApp channel supporting Lula's reelection campaign that had been ordered by another court official.

stories.title: Veja o que abre e fecha no feriado de 12 de outubro em São Paulo

en.title: See what opens and closes on October 12 holiday in São Paulo
en.summary: October 12 is a national holiday in Brazil commemorating Our Lady of Aparecida. Service hours for various São Paulo establishments will be altered on this date.

stories.title: FAB envia aviões para ajudar no combate a queimadas no Amazonas

en.title: Brazilian Air Force sends aircraft to help combat Amazon wildfires
en.summary: The Brazilian Air Force is deploying two KC-390 Millenium aircraft to assist with fighting forest fires in the Amazonas state regions of Manaus, Itacoatiara, and Parintins. The aircraft are expected to arrive at Manaus Air Base on Sunday evening and begin operations on Monday.

stories.title: Incêndios no Amazonas são criminosos e visam futuro desmatamento, diz ministro

en.title: Amazon fires are criminal and aimed at future deforestation, says minister
en.summary: Brazil's Environment Minister João Paulo Capobianco stated that Amazon wildfires indicate intentional human activity designed to degrade the biome and prepare terrain for future deforestation. Thirty-six municipalities in Amazonas state have declared emergency situations due to the fires.

stories.title: Após 1º turno, PL e Republicanos detêm 46% das receitas estaduais ao elegerem governadores em SP, MG, RJ e RS

en.title: After first round, PL and Republicanos control 46% of state revenues after electing governors in SP, MG, RJ and RS
en.summary: The PL and Republicanos parties secured governorships in São Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, and Rio Grande do Sul in the first election round. These four states together represent 46% of total state government revenues.

stories.title: Lula acusa Flávio Bolsonaro de mentir sobre propostas econômicas

en.title: Lula accuses Flávio Bolsonaro of lying about economic proposals
en.summary: President Lula accused Senator Flávio Bolsonaro of misrepresenting economic proposals and warned his government could cut social benefits and withhold above-inflation pension increases. Bolsonaro's team denies plans for social reductions.
